https://grothendieck.commutator.io/

Hi I started a bit of the Grothendieck handwritten notes just for fun, with my remaining Claude credits every week and have pretty good results.

I have LaTex file both in form of raw notes and modernized maths. Do you think it could be interesting to have a pipeline to transform LaTeX to LEAN and actually prove some of the assertions ?

Still using Claude Code, I also build a small website to help mathematicians "debug" the transcription more easily.

I am currently a data/AI engineer with a STEM background. I estimate it could take a year if I do this all by myself with a small budget, but can also write a batch pipeline using the Claude API.
